name.en-US: Mingling of the Water and Wine
name.pt-BR: Mistura da Água e do Vinho

patronOf.en-US: A little water is blessed and poured into the wine
patronOf.pt-BR: Um pouco de água é abençoado e posto no vinho

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Grant that, by the Mystery of this water and wine, we may be made partakers of His divine nature, who vouchsafed to be made partaker of our human nature.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Permiti que pela mistura simbólica desta água e deste vinho sejamos participantes da divindade daquele que quis assumir a nossa humanidade.

meta.basis: At the epistle corner the priest takes the chalice, 'sinistra tenens illius nodum', pours in the wine, then 'producit signum crucis super ampullam aquae, et dicit: Deus, qui humanae substantiae, et infundens parum aquae in Calicem prosequitur: Da nobis per hujus aquae et vini mysterium' (Ritus servandus VII.4). The prayer stands on the epistle-side altar card (Fortescue, l. 2986–2988). The offering of the chalice that follows, Offerimus tibi, has no card of its own.
